actions.content:
# Cavas Corporativas - Gate 10 UAT / Regression / Release Candidate

Gate final de certificacion previa a deploy.

## Dependencias cerradas
- Gate 1 Architecture: CERTIFIED 100%.
- Gate 2 SQL Evidence: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY 100%.
- Gate 3 Domain Core: CERTIFIED 100%.
- Gate 4 Repository/Service: CERTIFIED 100%.
- Gate 5 RBAC Contract Audit: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY 100%.
- Gate 6 E2E Integration: CERTIFIED 100%.
- Gate 7 Navigation/Menu: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY 100%.
- Gate 8 Composite UX/E2E/SQL/RBAC: CERTIFIED 100%.
- Gate 9 Physical Persistence: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY 100%.

## RC scope
- Domain, repository, service and routes compile and test together.
- Frontend builds with canonical route `/cavas-corporativas`.
- Canonical SQL menu remains unique and active.
- Physical Cavas Corporativas core remains 8 tables with idempotency index.
- RBAC physical permissions required by the module remain present.
- No Production writes or deploy happen in this gate.

If all checks pass, this dossier is the Release Candidate attestation for the subsequent production deployment gate.

queries.name: gate10_menu_rc
queries.sql: SELECT MenuID, Codigo, Ruta, RequierePermiso, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_ModulosMenus WHERE Codigo=N'cava.corporativas' OR Ruta=N'/cavas-corporativas' ORDER BY MenuID

queries.name: gate10_core_tables_rc
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name IN ('CavasCorporativas_OrganizacionesRef','CavasCorporativas_Convenios','CavasCorporativas_ConvenioUnidades','CavasCorporativas_Autorizados','CavasCorporativas_Beneficios','CavasCorporativas_BeneficioAlcances','CavasCorporativas_Politicas','CavasCorporativas_AplicacionesBeneficio') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate10_idempotency_index_rc
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_unique FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.name=N'CavasCorporativas_AplicacionesBeneficio' AND i.name=N'UQ_CC_Aplicacion_Idempotencia'

queries.name: gate10_rbac_permissions_rc
queries.sql: SELECT m.CodigoModulo, a.CodigoAccion, COUNT_BIG(*) AS GrantsActivos FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID WHERE prm.Activo=1 AND prm.Permitido=1 AND ((m.CodigoModulo=N'cava_socios' AND a.CodigoAccion=N'VER') OR (m.CodigoModulo=N'cava_socios.consumos' AND a.CodigoAccion=N'CREAR')) GROUP BY m.CodigoModulo,a.CodigoAccion ORDER BY m.CodigoModulo,a.CodigoAccion

constraints: Release Candidate only if every check passes
Expected Gate10 terminal: CERTIFIED + 100% + quality_gate PASS + tests PASS + production_touched false
